race.description: Spring Racing Carnival On Sale Now F&M Hcp (Bm78)
race.comment: SPIETHTACULAR (11) was poised to pounce here first up but cost herself after racing unkindly throughout. Better with that run under her belt and gets a key switch to Jones. Can go one better. DOMINANT DARCY (3) is a progressive mare resuming and a noted winner. Has been fitted with three trials and should be ready to run a big race. CINDERSEA (2) boasts similar formlines to Darcy and is unbeaten at this track. Just the one trial in readiness and gets in well at the weights with Youngberry's 3kg claim. BONFIRE SPARK (1) carries a fitness edge and only needs to hold her form to be right there at the pointy end again. JUST PRECIOUS (7) returns and boasts peaks that measure up, though she may need this off just one soft 850m trial.
